title: Leakage-aware calibrated decision-level fusion for mental-health text classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.19360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision-level fusion benefits from complementary errors, calibrated probabilities, and leakage-aware evaluation. We evaluated a heterogeneous transformer fusion framework on 262,276 proxy-labeled Reddit records covering anxiety, depression, schizophrenia, and suicidal ideation. In a stratified random split, MinHash-LSH identified 29.1% of test records as lexical near-duplicates of training data. Augmentation-lineage auditing found 50.2% lineage overlap with training, including 30.0% of records retained after lexical filtering. We therefore used lineage-disjoint partitions. Twelve encoders, comprising three seeds each of Bio-ClinicalBERT, MentalBERT, MentalRoBERTa, and RoBERTa-base, underwent cross-fitted validation for calibration and ensemble selection. A class-specific Complementarity Index (CI), defined as the Jaccard distance between members' correctly classified validation sets, was assessed against independent fusion gain. CI corr

translated_title: 面向心理健康文本分类的泄漏感知校准决策级融合
translated_abstract: 决策级融合受益于互补错误、校准概率和泄漏感知评估。我们在262,276条涵盖焦虑、抑郁、精神分裂症和自杀意念的代理标注Reddit记录上评估了一个异构transformer融合框架。在分层随机划分中，MinHash-LSH识别出29.1%的测试记录为训练数据的词汇近似重复；数据增强谱系审计发现50.2%的记录与训练集存在谱系重叠，其中包括经词汇过滤后仍保留的30.0%记录。因此，我们采用了谱系不相交的划分方式。十二个编码器——包括Bio-ClinicalBERT、MentalBERT、MentalRoBERTa和RoBERTa-base各三个随机种子——经过交叉拟合验证，用于校准和集成选择。我们定义了一个类别特定的互补性指数（CI），即各成员模型正确分类的验证集之间的Jaccard距离，并将其与独立评估的融合增益进行对照分析。CI与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于心理健康文本分类的泄漏感知校准决策级融合框架，通过谱系审计发现并消除了训练/测试数据泄漏，并创新性地提出互补性指数（CI）来指导编码器集成选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a leakage-aware calibrated decision-level fusion framework for mental-health text classification, which detects and eliminates train/test data leakage through lineage auditing and introduces a novel Complementarity Index (CI) to guide encoder ensemble selection.
